svg.title: Game development — Skill-tree spotlight
svg.desc: Four project contributions: object pooling, AI integration, skill tree, and development leadership. Embedded real project screenshots.

g.text: Players spend kill points to expand the rings, strengthen turrets and unlock zone effects.
Live tree / expansion, firepower and range
ScriptableObject nodes define costs, prerequisites and effects. Purchases check the node state and
balance before applying upgrades and refreshing the UI.
Player requests become structured game operations. Unity checks
the source text, known skills, targets and costs before spending
points and executing the plan. The companion then reports the
result, connecting a conversational request to a visible action on the
I prewarm and reuse enemies, projectiles and effects through a
shared object pool. On checkout, each instance resets its state; on
return, it is deactivated and stored for reuse. The same lifecycle
keeps frequent spawns organised during dense enemy waves.
As team captain and lead programmer, I coordinated Git contributions and
divided the work into clear tasks. I exposed gameplay and visual settings
through configuration assets and prefabs, so artists could tune the game
